versions.changelog:
lygo-mint-verifier v1.1.1 — Security-audit fixes, stricter consent enforcement

- `backfill_anchors.py` no longer auto-appends `--i-consent`; user must provide it explicitly.
- All compatibility wrappers strictly honor the consent gate; never inject consent flags.
- `self_check.py` now verifies enforcement of consent (“consent_wrapper_honest” and “backfill_requires_consent”).
- Security audit link added to SKILL.md; improved accuracy of declared permissions.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (`skill-card.md`).
v1.1.0: ClawHub security-audit harden — remove subprocess wrapper, in-process mint/verify/snippet/backfill, declared permissions, skill-card. Pairs with lygo-continuum-integrator + geodesic-sealer.

Clarify security model: document that scripts wrap local tools in tools/lygo_mint, recommend reviewing those helpers and using non-secret prompt packs / controlled environments for minting. Remove overstrong 'never print secrets' claim.
Initial release: deterministic pack hash + append-only and canonical ledgers + portable anchor snippet + anchor backfill.
